messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: canary_pipeline: healthcheck failures + 5xx rate breach on canary pool in eu-central-1. Threshold: 5% over 3m. See runbook: https://runbooks.internal/redwood/canary-failures
Aisha: on-call Aisha taking. paging infra and deploy. what's the scope?
Tom: seeing ~7.1% 5xx on /v1/stream and /v1/chat-stream. Only eu-central-1 canary nodes. Logs show repeated `model load failed: unable to allocate tensor` and container restarts.
Derek: I can confirm. Canary was at 25% traffic for variant-swap (quant-ev2) rolled out 20m ago. Metric spike aligns with swap start. Baseline routes (non-quant) unaffected.
Aisha: abort criteria looks met (5xx > 5% on canary). executing kill-switch and throttling via deploy-bot.
deploy-bot: Received action: `disable-feature variant-swap --env prod --region eu-central-1 --initiator Aisha`
deploy-bot: DONE - feature flag `variant-swap` disabled. Initiating traffic revert and drain of canary. :white_check_mark:
Tom: traffic moved back to baseline, canary pods are draining. 5xx trending down from 7.1% -> 1.2% in ~2m. healthchecks returning green.
Derek: stack traces show `cudaMalloc` failures and then an internal runtime segfault in quant kernel. suspect driver/kernel mismatch or too-small reserved mem for quant runtime.
Aisha: good mitigation. CS-bot please draft customer-facing note and surface orgs that reported errors.
CS-bot: Drafted: "We observed an elevated error rate for streaming requests in eu-central-1 during a feature rollout. We disabled the rollout and traffic reverted; customers may have seen failed streams between 08:12-08:18 UTC. Investigating root cause." Sending to CS for approval.
Tom: collecting failing request IDs and pod logs (will attach in incident ticket). also grabbing `dmesg` + oom-kill logs.
Derek: I'll reproduce in staging by forcing quant-ev2 load on a smaller GPU instance. early repro succeeded: quant kernel crashed when free mem < ~500MB.
Aisha: handoff: I'll lead immediate mitigation and evidence capture for 45m, then hand to Nina for follow-up and postmortem. Nina, you good to take the document owner?
Nina: yes, I'll own postmortem. please add me to ticket and include logs.
Derek: quick patch idea: add a pre-swap mem-check gating step in rollout pipeline and a kill switch to auto-fail swap if free GPU mem < threshold. I'll open a PR.
Tom: also propose to add a canary metric alert for quant-variant health specifically (separate from general 5xx) and shorten evaluation window to 2m for high-risk swaps.
Aisha: agree. action items: 1) Tom attach logs + request IDs (owner: Tom), 2) Derek PR for mem-gate (owner: Derek), 3) Nina postmortem (owner: Nina), 4) CS follow-up message (owner: Jess_Cs), 5) monitoring tweak (owner: Tom).
CS-bot: Notifying 5 orgs who reported errors; none are on Dedicated yet.
Nina: I'll schedule a blameless follow-up tomorrow and include risk matrix for quant rollouts.
Derek: note: possible long-term fix could be soft-fallback to non-quant model if kernel allocation fails during load. that would avoid aborting the whole service.
Tom: saving artifacts to incident/1721_canary_quant_swap. attaching heap profiles + errno logs.
Aisha: good. I'll close the active page after 30m of stability checks. please update ticket and thread if anything else pops up.
Nina: I'll run a verification script at +15m and post results.
deploy-bot: Traffic stable. Canary traffic 0% in eu-central-1.
incident-bot: Incident ticket 1721 created: status -> mitigated; responders: Aisha, Tom, Derek, Nina.
Aisha: confirmed stable at +25m. leaving handoff to Nina. closing immediate incident page. :lock_with_ink_pen:
Nina: noted. I'll kick off the postmortem draft and include timeline + remediation ETA. thanks team. :thumbsup:
